title: Navy patent for laser-drawn plasma decoys

tellings.quote:
right? Well, it turned out there's a
Navy patent to do exactly that, to draw
things in the shape of an airplane to
fool missiles.

plain: The US Navy holds a patent for using lasers to draw glowing plasma shapes in the sky, such as the shape of an airplane, to fool incoming missiles, according to Eric Haseltine, a former research director at the National Security Agency, the US agency for intercepting communications. He raises it as something he found out about, suggesting some strange sightings could be military decoys.
